name: @kirkelliott/ket
description: General-purpose quantum circuit simulator. Immutable TypeScript API, five backends, 14 import/export formats, zero dependencies.
author: kirkelliott

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --external:node:worker_threads --outfile=dist/ket.js && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --minify --format=esm --external:node:worker_threads --outfile=dist/ket.min.js && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --minify --format=iife --global-name=ket --log-override:empty-import-meta=silent --outfile=dist/ket.global.js && node scripts/build-compat-shim.ts && esbuild src/mps.worker.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=dist/mps.worker.js && esbuild src/stabilizer-rank.worker.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=dist/stabilizer-rank.worker.js && esbuild src/contraction.worker.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=dist/contraction.worker.js
scripts.deploy:site: node scripts/check-site-version.ts && node scripts/check-docs.ts && aws s3 sync site/ s3://dmvjs.com/ket/ --exclude '.DS_Store' --exclude 'README.md' && aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id E2NLJQLRPS1ZY5 --paths '/ket/*'
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run lint && npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm test
